description: Kyriba TMS Integration — DPX settlement bridge for Kyriba treasury management systems. Accepts a Kyriba-formatted payment instruction and executes it through the DPX settlement flow with oracle gating, compliance screening, and stablecoin routing. Returns a Kyriba-compatible confirmation response including settlement ID, execution status, and fee breakdown. The client's own Kyriba OAuth credentials are used — DPX never holds credentials. Useful for treasury teams running Kyriba who want DPX oracle intelligence and on-chain settlement without leaving their TMS workflow. Free (settlement x402 fee charged at execute step).

oauthToken.description: Client's Kyriba OAuth bearer token. Never stored by DPX.

paymentInstruction.description: Kyriba SPI payment instruction object — amount, currency, counterparty, valueDate.

sandbox.description: If true, oracle and compliance run live but no on-chain execution. Default true.

name: integration.kyriba

execution.description: On-chain execution params (sender-funded — client calls approve() + settle()).
